title: Chesapeake Curling Club
specs: Three sheets of dedicated curling ice
Hosts annual bonspiels and open curling sessions
Inclusive sport for all ages and abilities
Participants must be 13 years old or older for public Learn to Curl sessions
Must be able to deliver a 38-44 pound stone the length of the ice
Learn to Curl sessions limited to 24 tickets per session
Corporate and group events available by email inquiry
includes: All equipment needed to play provided
gap: Price for Learn to Curl sessions not stated
blurb: Guests can participate in 90 minute Learn to Curl group sessions to learn the basics of curling including delivering and sweeping the stone, basic strategy, and play a mini game. The club operates a three-sheet curling ice facility from December to March, hosting leagues, open curling sessions, and bonspiels.
extraNote: No registration required for Open House events · Talbot County Community Center in Easton, Maryland · December to March
